description: Opaque charcoal-brown knee-length wool tunic with narrow rust and gold geometric woven edging around a notched V neckline, sleeve ends and hem. A cream linen undershirt shows at the wrists and below the tunic hem. Plain brown leather waist belt with a small oval metal buckle, long loose strap and metal ring. Loose gray-brown trousers. Dark green-gray lower-leg wraps bound with crossing brown strips, and brown leather footwear. The clothing hangs naturally around an average adult frame. No helmet, head covering, armor or weapon is visible.
